tours.name: Desert Dune Buggies & Evening Safari Combo
tours.pickup_information: Hotel or residence pick-up included from anywhere in Dubai
tours.about: The Dune Buggy Adventure and Evening Desert Safari Combo package is a thrilling way to experience every side of the Dubai Desert. In a full afternoon and evening away from the beaten path, you will feel the bumps and turns of the dunes, spot the indigenous wildlife of the Dubai desert, and enjoy an evening of traditional Arabian hospitality in the company of our attentive team.
tours.short_description: The Dune Buggy Adventure and Evening Desert Safari Combo package is a thrilling way to experience every side of the Dubai Desert.
tours.full_description:
The Dune Buggy and Evening Safari Combo afternoon begins with a transfer from your hotel or residence to the Lisaili Camp, where you will experience the thrill of the dunes on a Dune Buggy Adventure. The Lisaili Camp is home to a set driving trail through which specially designed dune buggies weave their way along the bumps, turns and pivots of the desert. There are passenger and driver experiences available, both equally exhilarating.

Once your two-hour Dune Buggy Adventure is complete, we will take you on a short drive in our 4x4 vehicles over to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, where your Evening Desert Safari begins. The itinerary for the evening includes a wildlife drive, a camel ride on board on Arabian Camel, a short sandboarding lesson, a stop to watch the sun set over the Dubai desert, and a BBQ dinner in a traditional Bedouin setting, amongst the many unique moments you’ll experience throughout your time on the dunes.

The Dune Buggy Adventure follows a set path under the guidance of our experienced team of drivers. Before the experience, a full safety briefing will be provided by our team. We encourage all guests to enjoy a thrilling drive responsibly.

Our Dune Buggies & Evening Safari Combo offers the unique opportunity to experience the thrill of dune buggies in addition to one of our unforgettable desert safaris in the heart of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve (DDCR).
tours.highlights:
Transfers in a private, 4-wheel drive vehicle to and from both activities from your hotel or residence
Full driving brief from a trained driving instructor, including a safety briefing to ensure responsible enjoyment of the activity
Two-hour dune drive in a private 4-seater off-road dune buggy, for you and up to 3 other guests
All necessary equipment, including safety gear such as helmets and goggles
Complimentary refreshments throughout your Dune Buggy Adventure
Transfers between Al Lisaili Camp and the DDCR to take you from the Dune Buggy Adventure to the Evening Desert Safari
Thrilling 4x4 dune drive across the desert dunes
Camel ride on an Arabian Camel
Short sandboarding lesson
A sunset stop to watch one of nature’s greatest sights
BBQ dinner in a traditional Bedouin setting
Nature spotting opportunities throughout your time on the dunes
Unlimited soft drinks included in each package, with House and Premium upgrade options available
Optional shisha
A dedicated Arabian Adventures driver/guide throughout your safari
tours.know_before_you_go:
The Dune Buggy Adventure takes place in Lisaili, in a location separate to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve. Your activity includes private transfers in a 4-wheel drive vehicle to and from Lisaili
A security deposit of AED 5,000 is required for driver experiences and will be collected prior to the beginning of the activity. This will be returned as soon as the activity is completed with no damages. The deposit is to ensure the safety of both the guests and the equipment
Transfers to the Dune Buggy Adventure are in a private vehicle
We recommend comfortable clothing for this experience, including modest dress and comfortable shoes
All guests must wear closed shoes to ride the buggy. Flip-Flops and sandals are not accepted for safety reasons
Guests with pre-existing medical conditions and expectant mothers are not advised to participate in the Dune Buggy Adventure, but are welcome to join us for the majority of the Evening Desert Safari
The Arabian Adventures team reserve the right to stop your participation in the activity if we deem you to be acting in an unsafe manner. Please follow the safety instructions provided by the team before the activity begins to ensure an enjoyable experience which doesn’t compromise your safety
We recommend wearing comfortable clothing for your Evening Desert Safari, including sneakers/walking shoes and modest dress
Temperatures can fluctuate in the desert quite quickly. Warm afternoons can turn into cool evenings, particularly in the winter months. Please take this into account when deciding what to wear for your Evening Desert Safari
We recommend wearing sunscreen for your activity, and packing a pair of sunglasses and a hat
We will work to accommodate special dietary requirements when they are shared with us in advance. Please contact our team via WhatsApp on +971 4 274 8803 to share your requirements, or complete the form linked here, and we will work to accommodate your request.
Please inform our team of any existing medical conditions before joining us for your Evening Desert Safari. Where necessary, we will work to make alternative arrangements for certain activities to ensure the comfort and enjoyment of all guests throughout the experience
Please note, expectant mothers and guests with existing medical conditions will be required to skip the 4x4 dune drive for their comfort
tours.age_policy:
The minimum age requirement for drivers participating in a Dune Buggy Adventure is 16 years old, and must possess a valid driver’s license from their country of residence
Non-driving passengers accompanying the lead buggy must be at least 6+ and need to be seated with the adult accompanying them
Children aged between 6-13 can join the Dune Buggy Experience as non-drivers, only in a private vehicle with an adult from their group
For the Evening Desert Safari, a private vehicle must be booked for children aged between 2-5 or under 135cm, and details shared with our team at the time of booking
tours.cancellation_policy:
We understand that plans can change. If they do, please let us know at least 24 hours prior to your activity. We will not be able to process refunds for bookings cancelled less than 24 hours before your activity starts
Full payment for your booking is required at least two days prior to your activity. If payment is not received before the expected date, we reserve the right to cancel your activity
In exceptional circumstances, we may have to amend the Dune Buggy Adventure or the Evening Desert Safari schedule or cancel the activity entirely. We reserve the right to amend and cancel activities in such circumstances, and will ensure we communicate any changes in advance where possible
Both the Dune Buggy Adventure and Evening Desert Safari are subject to cancellation if weather conditions are not suitable. While we do our best to prepare for any adverse weather in advance, activities may be amended or cancelled as a result of bad weather
tours.additional_notes:
Price varies by vehicle, group sizes and other selections.
This product is not available for online bookings. Request a callback or WhatsApp +971 42748803 to book this tour.

tours.name: Desert Dune Buggies & Exclusive Desert Experience Combo
tours.pickup_information: Hotel or residence pick-up included from anywhere in Dubai
tours.about: The Dune Buggy Adventure and Exclusive Desert Experience package combines two of our most memorable desert activities in one incredible evening. Starting with a thrilling drive across the dunes and concluding with a magical night of private desert dining, this is the perfect experience to share with your partner, friends or family.
tours.short_description: The Dune Buggy Adventure and Exclusive Desert Experience package combines two of our most memorable desert activities in one incredible evening.
tours.full_description:
Our Dune Buggies & Evening Safari Combo offers the unique opportunity to experience the thrill of dune buggies in addition to one of our unforgettable desert safaris in the heart of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve (DDCR). The Dune Buggy Adventure takes place at Lisaili Camp and is one of the most unique driving experiences in the world, with the open road of Dubai’s super-highways swapped for the bumps, turns and pivots of the desert dunes. During this experience, you’ll get the opportunity to take the wheel and drive the buggy yourself, which is specially adapted for off-road driving and designed to tackle and conquer every dip along your route.

From here, the evening continues with the Exclusive Desert Experience, hosted in your very own corner of the Dubai desert. Here, you’ll enjoy a three-course BBQ dinner in a Bedouin-inspired dining space, served to your table by your personal waiter. Other inclusions on your Exclusive Desert Experience consist of a short camel ride with an Arabian Camel, a picturesque sunset stop with a glass of sparkling bubbles to raise a toast with, unlimited premium beverages, and plenty of stargazing and wildlife spotting opportunities.

This experience is ideal for couples, families or groups of best friends who want to share a memorable evening together while enjoying the thrill of a desert drive and the magic of desert dining. Whether you’re an adrenaline seeker or lover of life’s finer things, you’re covered by the Dune Buggy Adventure and Exclusive Desert Experience.

The individual itineraries of both products are included as part of this combo, including private transfers to and from your hotel or residence.

tours.name: Dune Buggy Adventure in Dubai
tours.short_description: Time to leave the open road behind and feel the rush of a ride only found in the desert.
tours.about: Time to leave the open road behind and feel the rush of a ride only found in the desert. Get ready for a unique, exhilarating dune buggy drive, swapping the famous Dubai supercars for an off-road, 4-wheel dune buggy.
tours.full_description:
If you’re looking for a unique thrill that can only be found in Dubai, it’s time to leave the open road and head for the desert. Here, you’ll find a Dune Buggy Adventure unlike anything you’ll experience anywhere else.

Set in the Lisaili camp just a short drive from the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, the Dune Buggy Adventure spans across a path of bumps, turns, pivots and dunes that make for the perfect circuit to experience a different kind of open road.

The Dune Buggy Adventure begins with transfers to and from your hotel or residence directly to the Lisaili Camp. If you’re joining us on a passenger experience, your transfer is the calmer form of chauffeur service you’ll enjoy! If you’re getting behind the wheel, your transfer is an opportunity to build your anticipation for the drive.

We follow a set path on the Dune Buggy Adventure, comprised of thrills and turns that create an exhilarating journey across the desert dunes. As for the dune buggy – they will be like nothing you’ve ever experienced before! They are a vehicle specially adapted for the desert, including wider tyres, larger wheels, and an open frame lined with reinforced barring to create a cocoon shape around the driver.

Before beginning your Dune Buggy Adventure, you will receive a full safety briefing from a member of our experienced driving team. They know the dunes like the back of their hand, and will clearly show you how to enjoy your drive safely. At this point, safety equipment will be handed out and you’ll be ready to hit the dunes.

You will follow an Arabian Adventures instructor along the dune buggy circuit, keeping good distance to ensure you’re able to feel the rush at every opportunity. The full session will last for up to 2 hours.

Your safety on the dunes is our top priority. If we feel you are acting in an unsafe manner or putting the safety of the group at risk, we reserve the right to stop your participation in the activity. We encourage all guests to enjoy a thrilling drive responsibly.

About: Time to leave the open road behind and feel the rush of a ride only found in the desert. Get ready for a unique, exhilarating dune buggy drive, swapping the famous Dubai supercars for an off-road, 4-wheel dune buggy.
Full description: If you’re looking for a unique thrill that can only be found in Dubai, it’s time to leave the open road and head for the desert. Here, you’ll find a Dune Buggy Adventure unlike anything you’ll experience anywhere else.

Set in the Lisaili camp just a short drive from the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, the Dune Buggy Adventure spans across a path of bumps, turns, pivots and dunes that make for the perfect circuit to experience a different kind of open road.

The Dune Buggy Adventure begins with transfers to and from your hotel or residence directly to the Lisaili Camp. If you’re joining us on a passenger experience, your transfer is the calmer form of chauffeur service you’ll enjoy! If you’re getting behind the wheel, your transfer is an opportunity to build your anticipation for the drive.

We follow a set path on the Dune Buggy Adventure, comprised of thrills and turns that create an exhilarating journey across the desert dunes. As for the dune buggy – they will be like nothing you’ve ever experienced before! They are a vehicle specially adapted for the desert, including wider tyres, larger wheels, and an open frame lined with reinforced barring to create a cocoon shape around the driver.

Before beginning your Dune Buggy Adventure, you will receive a full safety briefing from a member of our experienced driving team. They know the dunes like the back of their hand, and will clearly show you how to enjoy your drive safely. At this point, safety equipment will be handed out and you’ll be ready to hit the dunes.

You will follow an Arabian Adventures instructor along the dune buggy circuit, keeping good distance to ensure you’re able to feel the rush at every opportunity. The full session will last for up to 2 hours.

Your safety on the dunes is our top priority. If we feel you are acting in an unsafe manner or putting the safety of the group at risk, we reserve the right to stop your participation in the activity. We encourage all guests to enjoy a thrilling drive responsibly.
Experience Itinerary: 1 Pickup and journey to the desert 45 minutes
2 Safety and driving briefing Learn everything you need to know to make your experience safe and enjoyable. 15 minutes
3 Dune buggy experience Feel the thrill of a ride across the dunes in an off-road dune buggy as a passenger or a driver. 120 minutes
4 Photo stop Capture a special moment together to take as a souvenir of your experience. At your own pace
5 Return journey to your accommodation 45 minutes
Know before you go: The Dune Buggy Adventure takes place in Lisaili, in a location separate to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve. Your activity includes transfers to and from Lisaili in a shared vehicle

A security deposit of AED 5,000 is required for driver experiences and will be collected prior to the beginning of the activity. This will be returned as soon as the activity is completed with no damages. The deposit is to ensure the safety of both the guests and the equipment
We recommend comfortable clothing for this experience, including modest dress and comfortable shoes
All guests must wear closed shoes to ride the buggy. Flip-Flops and sandals are not accepted for safety reasons
Guests with pre-existing medical conditions and expectant mothers are not advised to participate in this activity

tours.name: Three-Day Camping Adventure
tours.short_description: This is the ultimate desert adventure your students will never forget.
tours.about: This is the ultimate desert adventure your students will never forget. Kids will love the excitement of three days and two nights surrounded by the dunes learning about wildlife and conservation and camping under the stars.
tours.full_description:
From the entrance to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, the Arabian Adventures guides will drive your group through the dunes to camp. While the kids learn how to build their tents, we’ll prepare a delicious barbecue dinner. After a hearty meal, it’s time for a night-time nature stroll where you can spot wildlife and enjoy stargazing in the tranquility of the desert.

On day two, you’ll start with a hot breakfast before a morning nature walk to see the desert in a different light. Take part in a desert clean up, then go camel trekking and sandboarding down the dunes. After lunch at camp, you’ll explore the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve Visitor Centre to learn all about wildlife, heritage and conservation. Then it’s time for an exciting GPS treasure hunt. After dinner at camp, we’ll have fun on a team building activity and end the day toasting marshmallows around the bonfire.

On day three, it’s breakfast and a falcon show. Then we’ll break down the camp and head to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve gate to end your fantastic desert adventure.
tours.highlights:
Day 1 Highlights - Hands-on desert camp building | Evening wildlife walk and stargazing
Day 2 Highlights - Morning nature walk, desert clean-up, camel trekking, and sandboarding | Educational experiences in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve Visitor Centre | Exciting fun, games and team-building activities, with a bonfire and marshmallow roasting
Day 3 Highlights - Falcon show

tours.name: Overnight Wildlife Adventure
tours.short_description: Enjoy a day of discovery in the desert as you learn about wildlife and United Arab Emirates heritage, then watch the stars come out as you stay overnight in our camp.
tours.about: Enjoy a day of discovery in the desert as you learn about wildlife and United Arab Emirates heritage, then watch the stars come out as you stay overnight in our camp.
tours.full_description:
The adventure begins at the entrance to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve where our guides will take your group on desert drive to our camp. Your class will learn how to build tents while we prepare a delicious barbecue dinner, with an enthralling fire show and traditional Arabic tanoura dance take place as the stars come up over camp.

After dinner, you’ll take your UV lights on an evening wildlife walk to look for wild animals and observe them in their natural habitat. Then back at camp, you’ll toast marshmallows around the campfire, enjoy stargazing, and settle into your tent for the night.

After a hearty breakfast, you’ll enjoy sandboarding down the dunes and camel trekking. Throughout the trip, you’ll learn about the preservation work of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, the history of the desert and its role in Emirati culture.

tours.name: Morning Wildlife Safari
tours.short_description: Take a morning 4x4 wildlife drive through the beautiful Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve and learn about the importance of environmental preservation on this half-day safari and discovery experience.
tours.about: Take a morning 4x4 wildlife drive through the beautiful Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve and learn about the importance of environmental preservation on this half-day safari and discovery experience.
tours.full_description:
The Arabian Adventures guides will welcome you at 9am to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, when one group will go on a 4x4 wildlife safari across the dunes while the other group will explore the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve Visitor Centre. Then, we’ll swap activities before finishing with a break at the Visitor Centre, followed by a 1pm departure.

On the wildlife safari, you’ll spend 1.5 hours on a dune drive looking out for gazelles, reptiles, birds, oryx and more desert animals. Along the way, you’ll visit the camel farm, spot birds at the lake, and make stops for photos.

At the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve Visitor Centre, you’ll enjoy a guided tour through six rooms of exhibits and interactive experiences to learn all about the environment, wildlife and the importance of conservation.

An immersive desert wildlife safari experience
An educational journey through the visitor center
Wildlife spotting passport activity
